name: iso-ansi-remap
title: ISO to ANSI Keyboard Remap
description: Turn the § key into ` ~ and the key beside the short left Shift into Shift on a MacBook ISO keyboard.
author: roman.tyshyk

commands.name: show-remap-status
commands.title: Show Remap Status
commands.description: Show whether the remap and its autostart are on, and turn them on or off.

commands.name: enable-remap
commands.title: Enable Remap
commands.description: Remap the built-in keyboard now. It lasts until you log out or restart, unless autostart is installed.

commands.name: disable-remap
commands.title: Disable Remap
commands.description: Restore the § key and the key beside the left Shift now. Autostart turns the remap back on at the next login.

commands.name: install-autostart
commands.title: Install Autostart
commands.description: Turn the remap on at every login with a LaunchAgent, and turn it on now.

commands.name: remove-autostart
commands.title: Remove Autostart
commands.description: Remove the LaunchAgent and turn the remap off.

scripts.fix-lint: ray lint --fix && eslint --fix test vitest.config.mts && prettier --write test vitest.config.mts
scripts.lint: ray lint && eslint test vitest.config.mts && prettier --check test vitest.config.mts
